create_RNN_module: create an RNN module with LSTM or GRU architecture for actor-critic networks
build_Conv2d_tf_layer: build a Conv2d layer with TensorFlow-style same padding behavior
create_Flatten_module: create a Flatten module to reshape tensors keeping batch dimension
build_fc_layers: build fully connected layers with tanh activation and orthogonal weight initialization
apply_init_to_modules: apply Xavier uniform initialization to Conv2d and BatchNorm2d modules
